_comment: Analyzer chain thresholds. One section per analyzer in jb/src/core/Images/Analyzers/. All edge/channel thresholds use the normalized [0,1] pixel scale (e.g. 0.1176 = 30/255).
_comment_filename: OrientationTokens maps a filename token to a hero-orientation value. It is deliberately NOT the same list as DetOrderKeywordStems.json: that one maps filename hints to det slots and carries six groups that name no orientation at all (detail, pack, label, material, lifestyle, interior). The two overlap on the orientation-bearing groups only, and a language variant added to one does not belong in the other by default — widening this vocabulary is a calibration question tracked under T-4000's Analyzer_FilenameEvidence entry, not a sync chore. T-5000 (2026-08-05) moved this map out of a hard-coded dictionary in Analyzer_FilenameEvidence.cs; the entries are unchanged from that dictionary.

ShadowPresence._comment: shadow-present is published straight from the subject detector's stripped-thin-line evidence, so the confidence reflects trust in that shape test rather than a separate measurement. Held below the geometry analyzers: a thin texture-only line is good evidence of a hard shadow edge, but a soft shadow leaves no such line and reads as false.
